concept.hr: 2,4 GHz 1/6/11, širine kanala na 5 GHz, smetnje na istom kanalu
concept.en: 2.4 GHz 1/6/11, 5 GHz channel widths, co-channel interference

summary.hr: Postavi access pointove na kanale: isti kanal znači izmjenu u eteru, djelomično preklapanje kvari okvire, a šire kanale na 5 GHz plaćaš manjim brojem kanala.
summary.en: Put access points on channels: the same channel means taking turns, a partial overlap corrupts frames, and wider 5 GHz channels cost you channels.
